notes: LS-MM8510-S3I ordering variant: -40°C to +85°C Industrial; LS-MM8510-S3C: 0°C to +70°C Standard. Optical power launched into MMF. Receiver sensitivity and overload measured with PRBS 2^31-1 @ 10312 Mbps, BER ≤ 1×10^-12. Data rate table lists Min 1.0, Typical 10.3, Max 10.7 (unit shown as bps in table). Supply current Icc max 260 mA at 3.135–3.465 V; power in watts not stated. SMSR row has no numeric limits in table.
